messages:
alex: Heads-up — hacked together a tiny cheatsheet for a faster canary + rollback flow using the deploy bot. dropping here for feedback and any missing safety checks.

maya: Love this. high level — what do you want the bot to enforce vs just provide shortcuts?

alex: goal: 1) one-line canary start (pin + %), 2) quick metrics check command that aggregates the last 10m errors/latency, 3) single rollback command that records reason and pins previous version.

darren: For (2) can we have the bot call our perf-summary endpoint and post a small table? keeps it eyeballable.

ci-bot: note: new /deploy-lite command merged to staging. usage: `/deploy-lite model=v2.3.1 canary=10% window=30m`

jamie: idea: make `/deploy-lite --dryrun` output the plan and required approvals. avoid accidental change-window breaches.

sasha: +1 on approvals. also add a quick `--revert-to` flag that auto-populates the previous pinned version in the comment. reduce human typing during incidents.

alex: sketch of the helper script i've been using locally:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# deploy-lite.sh - wrapper for deploy bot + perf checks
MODEL=$1 # e.g. v2.3.1
CANARY=${2:-10}%
WINDOW=${3:-30m}
/deploy --model="$MODEL" --canary="$CANARY" --window="$WINDOW" --meta="initiated-by:$USER"
# wait small buffer then call perf-summary
sleep 20
curl -sS https://ops-api.internal/perf-summary?model=$MODEL&window=10m | jq .summary
```

maya: can we centralize this as a template in the repo (eng/release/templates) and make the bot execute it? then we get audit logs and standardization.

darren: also add a preflight lint: check that the model and version exist in the model-catalog, and that change-window isn't overlapping scheduled maint windows.

alex: agreed. proposal: add two bot subcommands: `/deploy-lite plan` (prints plan YAML), `/deploy-lite exec` (runs plan, posts perf check card, and pins). default rollback command: `/deploy-lite rollback reason=<text>` which triggers immediate pin to last-known-good and logs ticket link.

ci-bot: autotag:release-tooling v1.0 applied to thread.

jamie: UX nit: for pinning steps, show a short diff of model config and quantization flags the runtime will apply — helps us avoid surprise perf regressions.

sasha: Ops: we should add an escape hatch: `/deploy-lite force-rollback` that requires two approvers in production. incident-mode will bypass normal change-window checks.

alex: good call. i'll draft a PR with: the template in repo, a wrapper script, and bot command handlers. will include rollback audit fields: reason, triage owner, incident link.

maya: sweet. if you want i can pair on the preflight checks tomorrow.

alex: thanks — i'll ping when PR is ready. :thumbsup:
